answer: The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, reduced by each unverified claim, rewards vest against future work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the whisper of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the lantern of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the pulse re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
